sn33.1:1.2: This Saṁyutta can be seen as a supplement to the “Vacchagotta trilogy” ([mn71](), [mn72](), and [mn73]()), which depicts Vacchagotta’s growth from a curious skeptic to a realized master; see notes there for details. His verse is at [thag1.112](), and he also features in [sn44.7]()–11 and [an3.57]().
